Road

Mulbrydale approach

SELECTED OBJECTIVE
Go to the Inn at the Crossroads.
WHAT TO DO
Follow the quest route through Mulbrydale and toward the inn.
The priest west of Mulbrydale offers Funeral Pyres.
John Verdun’s encounter is along the riverbank on this approach.
Their guides remain separate activities.
WHY

Open each nearby activity’s owner hub below. Taking a detour does not advance or complete the main quest.

The Inn

Inn at the Crossroads

SELECTED OBJECTIVE
Ask about the agent called Hendrik at the Inn at the Crossroads.
WHAT TO DO
Ask the innkeeper about Hendrik.
Resolve the interruption by the Baron’s men, then finish the conversation with the innkeeper to learn where to look next.
WHY

You can read the notice board and inspect the innkeeper’s services while at this stop. Collecting a notice is not completing its contract.

4.reading:
Heatherton

Hendrik’s hut

SELECTED OBJECTIVE
Look for the agent called Hendrik in the village of Heatherton.
WHAT TO DO
Deal with the rabid dogs and speak to the survivor.
Search Hendrik’s body, including his boots, for the key.
Examine the animal-skin rug—or move it with Aard—to reveal the cellar entrance.
Below, examine the candlestick to reveal the hidden compartment and read Hendrik’s notes.
WHY

Reading the notes finishes this quest and provides two investigative leads. Mark completion separately in the owner hub when you have done this in the game.
